review:
Gods of Giza is an Egyptian cluster slot on a 5×5 grid, where three or more touching symbols form a win. Winning symbols cascade away, and every win also creates a wild, so later wins become easier within the same sequence.

Some wilds carry a countdown that drops by one with each win they are part of before they disappear. Four or more scatters award 15 free spins, and more scatters unlock more, up to 120 spins in total. Pragmatic lists a 96.01% RTP. It suits players who like cascading cluster games with long bonus rounds.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
